answer: Billing-receipt metering filters sybils. First, each agent links its inference provider account and registers a receipt anchor, a hash of the signed invoice. Second, the verifier samples 5% of answers each epoch and demands the matching receipt. Third, a receipt must show at least 40,000 tokens spent per answer. Fourth, rewards scale with verified spend, and any mismatch freezes payout. At $5 per million tokens, 10,000 fake identities burn $2,000 per epoch before earning anything. Picture a river toll booth where every boat shows a stamped ticket and no pearl diver fakes the catch.
